questions: How many devices did you fabricate and measure, and in how many did you see the Ic oscillations, the diode sign reversal and the spectral jumps? Your text says the global signatures "are also observed in all examined devices" (p. 4); a number would help.

Why were the other devices set aside? You note that "the yield of functional tunnel junctions fabricated on top remains below 50%" (p. 5); did devices with one or no working probe still show the global signatures, and are they in the Zenodo set?

Which ranges did you measure beyond the ones shown? For example, Fig. S4 maps device B over a wider gate range than the ±30 V of Fig. 4, and all data are at base temperature; were field angle or temperature series taken?

What does the second-best device look like for the device A result, where a ZBP appears at the half-flux jump (Fig. 1f-g)? Did any other device show a ZBP that appears at the transition and leaves at the next one?

For device C, Table S1 (16 nm by 80 nm) puts one flux quantum near 1.6 T, so 3Φ0/2 would sit near 2.4 T, yet Fig. S3d-e at Bx = 2.5 T is described as "within the expected first topological regime". Which flux period did you use for device C, and where does 2.5 T fall on it?

How does the end-to-end correlation in Fig. 4l and Fig. S3l treat small curvatures: is there a threshold on the size of the second derivative of G, and how were the gate points and bias resolution chosen? Relatedly, device C's ZBP "was mostly absent" in Fig. S2b-c while Fig. S3l reports "a strong increase of correlated zero-bias conductance peaks" in the first topological regime; which gate voltage is Fig. S2 taken at?

For the diode data, was the field swept in both directions, given that the high-field jumps show a "strong dependence on the magnetic-field sweep direction" (p. 4)? And does the size or sign of η around half a flux quantum track the top-bottom asymmetry you tune with VG (Fig. S4), as an ordinary two-junction interferometer diode would?
What were the filter and line resistances subtracted in the two-terminal dV/dI and in the nonlocal correction (Supplementary S1.C), and could you show one nonlocal map before correction?
